wedo_instance.description: Reusable 7-Task WeDo-JSON Boilerplate (TFC-DISCOVER-01 through TFC-VERIFY-07) and 5-Category Substantive Audit Protocol for Google Meet Transcript & Gemini Summary Strikes

meta.philosophy: Deterministic OpenXML (<w:t>) Google Doc patching grounded in local _repsl cross-referencing, external web verification, and Gemini Summary misrepresentation auditing.

audit_categories.Category_A: and fixing misattributed quotes in the summary/notes.
audit_categories.Category_B: Sovereign Stack & Technical Terms: REPSL (Read-Eval-Print Strange Loop), Hierarchical Script-Database, Neowise Computers, Ixian LLC, Isle Ventures, *.isle.ventures subdomains, ERC-7827, LNA-33X, ERC-8004, x402, Base Scale Calculus, Thales's theorem, GNU Screen, Google OAuth.
audit_categories.Category_C: Venture, Legal & Regulatory Architecture: Decile Group / Decile Hub / Decile Capital, VC Lab, Founder Institute, Adeo Ressi, PACT, Series LP / Series LLC / Ricardian LLC, SEC Rule 506(b), Statute of Anne, Article I, Section 8, Clause 8, LexDAO / LexClinic, 501(c)(3) / 501(c)(4), Cahill, Form 1023, MiCA, shareholder primacy.
audit_categories.Category_D: External Partners, People, Universities & Venues: Proper spelling and institutional roles of guests, DAO directors, protocol authors, professors, legislators, and event venues.
audit_categories.Category_E: Gemini Summary Logic & Factual Alignment: Ensuring every bullet in Quick notes, Summary, Decisions, Next steps, and Details accurately reflects who said what and how the legal/technical architecture actually works.

tasks.description: Drive Discovery & Ownership/Audio Check: Locate target Google Meet folder and Document ID on Drive, check whether the file is owned by you (patch in-place) or shared by an external collaborator (patch in-place if editable and/or create an (Upgraded) copy), and check if raw audio/video (.mp4/.m4a) exists.

Plain-Text Export & <w:t> XML Run Inspection: Export the full Google Doc to plain text for line-by-line reading and inspect the OpenXML <w:t> text runs in word/document.xml via py/substrate/transcript_strike.py inspect to see how phrases are segmented.

Local _repsl Repository Cross-Reference: Cross-check all internal project names, subdomains, standards (LNA-33X, ERC-7827, ERC-8004, x402), legal agreements, patents, and prior call transcripts against local kairos_repsl, chronos_repsl, and data_room_repsl.
External Web Verification: Run targeted web searches to verify external people, titles, companies, protocols, universities, venues, legislation, and books/papers.

Gemini Summary & Attribution Misrepresentation Audit: Audit Gemini's generated Quick notes, Summary, Decisions, Next steps, and Details against the verbatim transcript to fix speaker attribution artifacts, entity/person conflations, and role/claim inversions.

Deterministic XML Patch & Drive API Upload: Compile the replacements JSON map, apply it to word/document.xml, validate XML structure (ET.fromstring), and upload via py/substrate/transcript_strike.py patch (moving any temporary files to /home/mgit/metagit_trash/).

Live Drive Verification & Chronos Anchoring: Re-export the live Google Doc from Drive to verify 0 remaining old error strings, confirm occurrence counts of all corrected terms, and record the completed MISSION-TRANSCRIPT-*.wedo.json manifest in chronos_repsl/wedo/.
